solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Caught in tragedy in volatile urban development

indicators.note: volatile means unstable and changeable, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A catastrophe strikes an unstable new housing scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'in' is only a link; the anagram takes C with TRAGEDY and the second IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A garden city is a planned town laid out with green spaces, a kind of urban development.

clue.text: Song about People's Republic

indicators.note: about means going round, so the song wraps around the people

parts.note: an aria is a solo song in an opera
men means people

explanation.surface: A patriotic anthem is written about a communist People's Republic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'People's Republic' reads as one phrase, but it splits: People's gives MEN and Republic is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Armenia is a sovereign state in the Caucasus with a republican constitution.

clue.text: Material removed from the ground that's raised

indicators.note: in a down clue raising a word means reading it from the bottom up

parts.note: mined means dug out of the earth

explanation.surface: Something dug out of the earth is brought to the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Denim is a hard-wearing cotton fabric, a material used for jeans.

clue.text: Christmas over: roast served up is pig

indicators.note: in a down clue being served up means turned upward, so the run is read bottom to top

parts.note: Noel is another word for Christmas
O is the cricket abbreviation for over
to roast or pan is to criticise severely

explanation.surface: Once Christmas is over, the roast pork comes to the table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served up' sounds like dishing out the roast, but it turns NOEL, O and PAN upside down together.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon is the domineering boar who seizes power in Orwell's novel Animal Farm.

clue.text: Electrical device in home — timers are reset

indicators.note: reset means arranged again, so these letters are put into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone resets the timers on a household appliance.
explanation.definitionFit: An immersion heater is an electric element that heats water in a domestic tank.

clue.text: Plague surging northward to devour atomic plant

indicators.note: devouring means swallowing, so one piece takes the other inside it
in a down clue going north means reading upward, so the word is reversed

parts.note: to plague someone is to worry them
A stands for atomic, as in A-bomb

explanation.surface: A spreading blight engulfs a nuclear power plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Yarrow is a feathery-leaved flowering herb, Achillea millefolium.

clue.text: Corned beef dish in mess

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a fried mix of chopped meat and potato

explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a dish served in an army mess; 'in' is only a link between two meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both chopped fried leftovers and, idiomatically, a botched job.

clue.text: Farm steward managed church bar

parts.note: a hind is an old word for a farm worker or steward
ran means managed
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A farm manager ran the local church bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A hindrance is an obstacle, something that bars progress.

clue.text: Victor looked outside — lacking in cheer?

indicators.note: the looking word sits outside, wrapped around the other piece

parts.note: stared means looked hard
Victor is V in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: Victor gazed out of the window, feeling glum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cheer' here has its old sense of food and drink, as in good cheer, so lacking it means hungry.
explanation.definitionFit: Starved means deprived of food, and cheer is an old word for fare or provisions.

clue.text: Lady wife leaves for the country

indicators.note: leaves means goes away, so that letter is dropped

parts.note: a lady is a woman

explanation.surface: A married woman moves out to live in the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Oman is a sultanate on the south-east tip of the Arabian peninsula.

clue.text: Unhinged man in opera one surely barking?

indicators.note: unhinged means deranged, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A deranged character in an opera must surely be mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'barking' looks like British slang for crazy, matching 'Unhinged', but it means a dog that barks.
explanation.definitionFit: A Pomeranian is a small fluffy toy dog breed, known for yapping.

clue.text: Thin plate sent back for that Muppet on the drums

indicators.note: sent back means returned, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: a lamina is a thin layer or plate

explanation.surface: A cymbal is returned for the Muppet drummer.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal is the wild drummer in The Muppet Show's house band, Dr Teeth and the Electric Mayhem.

clue.text: River I love that's wonderful — its Mexican name?

parts.note: R is the map abbreviation for river
love is zero in tennis, written O
bravo is a cry of applause for something wonderful

explanation.surface: A traveller enthuses about a river and asks what Mexicans call it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'its' points back to the river the wordplay began with: the Rio Grande.
explanation.definitionFit: Mexicans call the border waterway known in the US as the Rio Grande by this Spanish name.

clue.text: Dandy advanced — vehicle going into M1?

indicators.note: into means placed inside, so these pieces sit within the other

parts.note: M1 is written MI, reading the figure 1 as the letter I
a car is a vehicle
on means going, as in a show that is on

explanation.surface: A fop drives his car onto the M1, Britain's main motorway north from London.
explanation.definitionFit: A macaroni was an 18th-century fop who affected Continental fashions.

clue.text: American rebel involves old plane in sudden attack

indicators.note: involves means wraps up, so one piece holds the other within it

parts.note: Jack Cade led a revolt against Henry VI in 1450
bus is old flying slang for an aircraft

explanation.surface: A US insurgent takes over a vintage aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambuscade is an old word for an ambush, an attack from hiding.

clue.text: Revealing work in new Cornish resort bishop banned

indicators.note: banned means excluded, so that letter is removed

parts.note: Bude is a seaside town in Cornwall
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A risqué artwork goes on show at a seaside town, and the bishop has it banned.
explanation.definitionFit: A nude is a painting or sculpture of an unclothed figure, an artwork that reveals all.

clue.text: Go out with farewell in Welsh town

parts.note: ebb means go out, as the tide does
vale is Latin for farewell

explanation.surface: Someone leaves a Welsh town after saying goodbye.
explanation.definitionFit: Ebbw Vale is a former steel town in the South Wales valleys.

clue.text: In grammar class might one be taught?

definitions.text: In grammar class might one be taught?

parts.words: In grammar class might one be taught
parts.note: reads like a lesson at school, but 'taught' is itself a word belonging to a particular class in grammar

explanation.walkthrough: 'grammar class' suggests a school lesson; it is the word class, and 'taught' belongs to it.
explanation.definitionFit: Taught is a doing word, the past tense of teach, so it belongs to this part of speech.

clue.text: Nobleman given award for organ piece?

parts.note: an earl is a nobleman
an OBE is a British honour, Officer of the Order of the British Empire

explanation.surface: An aristocrat is honoured for a composition for the church organ.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organ piece' sounds like music, but the organ is the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: The earlobe is the soft lower part of the ear, a sense organ.

clue.text: Eugene O'Neill's piece, as an example?

definitions.text: Eugene O'Neill's piece, as an example?

parts.words: Eugene O'Neill's piece, as an example
parts.note: a piece of the words Eugene O'Neill spells a gas element, and that element is one example of the answer

explanation.walkthrough: 'piece' suggests one of O'Neill's plays; it is letters inside his name, eugeNE O'Neill, giving NEON, which is one of the inert gases.
explanation.definitionFit: Neon is one of the inert elements in group 18 of the periodic table, so it exemplifies this class.

clue.text: Unseen at first, little girl climbing on the bed?

indicators.note: the first letter is not seen, so it is removed

parts.note: a baby is a little one

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means read from the bottom up

parts.note: a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: A small girl climbs onto the bed without anyone noticing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'little girl' looks like one phrase, but 'little' is BABY losing its B to give ABY, and 'girl' alone is LASS, turned upward to SSAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Abyssal describes the deepest ocean depths, the zone found on the sea bed.

clue.text: Package right put in place for sorting

indicators.note: put in means inserted, so the right letter goes inside the place word
sorting means rearranging, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: A package is put in the right place at the sorting office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for sorting' rearranges PLACE to PACEL, and 'put in' places R inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A parcel is a wrapped bundle sent through the post.

clue.text: Will fastest guns win this militaristic competition?

definitions.text: Will fastest guns win this militaristic competition?

parts.words: Will fastest guns win this militaristic competition
parts.note: pictures a Wild West shoot-out, but the contest is nations stockpiling weapons

explanation.walkthrough: 'fastest guns' evokes a gunfight; the competition is between nations building weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a contest between states to build up ever greater military weaponry, as in the Cold War.

clue.text: Pleasing victory announced in 1

indicators.note: announced means spoken out loud, so the letters entered match the sound

parts.note: well means pleasing, as in all is well, and win means victory

explanation.surface: A satisfying win is declared.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 is the answer to 1 across: Welwyn Garden City in Hertfordshire.
explanation.definitionFit: Welwyn is the first word of the name of Britain's second garden city, founded in 1920.

clue.text: Ring round to collect island flower

indicators.note: collect means gather in, so the island letter is taken inside
round means turned about, so the word is reversed

parts.note: to ring is to call on the phone
I is the map abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: Someone phones around to pick up some flowers from an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Lilac is a shrub bearing fragrant purple or white blossoms.

clue.text: Province not one area in which we find da Gama?

indicators.note: the phrase says one piece is found inside the other

parts.note: taken as written
Vasco da Gama was the Portuguese explorer who sailed to India
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An explorer turns up somewhere he never actually sailed.
explanation.definitionFit: Nova Scotia is a maritime province on Canada's Atlantic coast.

clue.text: Cat in wood by lake

indicators.note: by means next to, so the two pieces stand side by side

parts.note: ash is a hardwood tree

explanation.surface: A cat lurks in the woods beside a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cat' is not an animal here but the cat-o'-nine-tails, a whip.
explanation.definitionFit: The cat-o'-nine-tails was a knotted whip, so the cat is a lash.

clue.text: Great footballer training with the French

parts.note: PE is physical education, training at school
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A star player trains with the French team.
explanation.definitionFit: Pelé was the Brazilian forward who won three World Cups.

clue.text: 'Massive' ordered lagers and cold beer

indicators.note: ordered means put in order, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: C is the tap abbreviation for cold
ale is a type of beer

explanation.surface: Someone orders a massive round of lager and chilled beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Large-scale means extensive or on a big scale, much like huge.
